items.text: Good food for a good mind and a good life.

paragraphs: Vegan Garden is more than a restaurant – it is a journey through flavour, mindfulness and compassion.
Inspired by the rich culinary heritage of Vietnam, we cook 100 % plant-based, with fresh, natural ingredients that bring balance to your body and calm to your mind.
storyTeaser.script: The Art of Purity and Peace
storyTeaser.quote: We believe that food has the power to heal, to connect and to create a better world for all.
storyTeaser.imageAlt: Vegan Garden dining room with wooden tables and the golden lotus logo on the wall

commitment.title: Our Commitment to You

paragraphs: Our signature dishes celebrate authentic Vietnamese flavours, reimagined with plants.
Every plate is crafted with care, fresh ingredients and a touch of love.

quoteBand.quote: Let food be thy medicine and medicine be thy food.
quoteBand.author: Hippocrates
quoteBand.ctaTitle: Ready for the art of purity?

whyUs.title: A restaurant that nourishes – not just fills
whyUs.text: From the first scent of the broth to the last sip of tea, we want you to feel completely at ease.

items.title: Kitchen full of handwork
items.text: Our broths simmer for hours, rice paper is rolled fresh, sauces are made new every day.

items.title: Honest ingredients
items.text: Seasonal vegetables, tofu from a Berlin producer and herbs we source fresh each morning.

items.title: A calm dining room
items.text: Plenty of green, warm wood and soft light – a place where you truly arrive.

items.title: Made for everyone
items.text: Gluten-free and nut-free options, mild and spicy dishes – just let us know.

paragraphs: Step into a space where nature meets pleasure. Our restaurant is a peaceful retreat from the rush of the city.
Surrounded by lush green, warm wood and soft daylight, every detail invites you to slow down, breathe and enjoy the moment.
